title: Golfclub Seefeld-Wildmoos

kurzbeschreibung: Golfclub Seefeld-Wildmoos is a high-alpine gem belonging to the Leading Golf Courses of Austria at nearly 1,300 metres above sea level.
beschreibung:
Alpine Golf Jewel at 1,300 Metres

Golfclub Seefeld-Wildmoos is widely regarded by connoisseurs as a true masterpiece created by renowned golf course architect Donald Harradine. Situated on a high plateau near Seefeld at nearly 1,300 metres above sea level, the course blends seamlessly into the gently rolling landscape.

Untouched Nature and Premier Standards

As a member of the Leading Golf Courses, Seefeld-Wildmoos meets the very highest quality benchmarks. The fairways wind their way through sunlit coniferous woods, past vibrant alpine meadows and picturesque moorlands, all framed by the striking peaks of the Karwendelgebirge and Wettersteingebirge in the background.
